text: Hi Mara — Professor Alvarez asked me to set up next week's CSE455 staff meeting. Could you send me your availability for next week (Mon 23 – Fri 27 Nov, 09:00–17:00)? I'll find a slot that works for everyone.

One honest request though: my section of next week's material won't be ready by then, so a staff meeting on the 23rd–27th would have me walking everyone through something half-finished. If the earlier date is fixed for other reasons, I'll make it work and we can keep my part short.

If you need a full hour, the only way is to move something of Sarah's; she's away this week and asked me to use my judgement, so tell me the preferred hour and why it matters and I'll let you know what I can shift.

Understood — 23–27 Nov it is if the Professor wants that, and I'll keep my part short. Thanks for being flexible; if it shifts to 30 Nov – 4 Dec, just tell me.

One more thing so you can lock it in: any 30-minute slot Mon 23 – Fri 27, 09:00–17:00 works for me — mornings are marginally easier, but I'll fit whatever suits the Professor and the others. Just send the date and time and I'll accept.
